summary: 荷兰导演伊文思1938年来华拍摄纪录片《四万万人民》，记录中国抗战并赢得国际声援。他早年凭《桥》《雨》获称“电影诗人”，后受左翼思想影响成为“电影战士”。在武汉他拍摄周恩来、叶剑英等共产党人的珍贵画面，离开前将摄影机与胶片赠予八路军，促成延
summary_en: Dutch director Joris Ivens, known as 'film poet' and later 'film warrior', came to China in 1938 to film 'The 400 Million' documenting China's resistance; in Wuhan he captured rare footage of Zhou Enlai, Ye Jianying and other Communists and gave his camera and film to the Eighth Route Army.

title: 为亚洲篮球注入活力（竞技观察）
title_en: Injecting vitality into Asian basketball (Sports Observation)
summary: 2026亚洲大学生篮球联赛8月11日在杭州结束，上海交通大学队以72∶69险胜台湾政治大学队夺冠，球员陈天灿获最佳球员。本届赛事国际化进程加速，中国高校球队由7支调整至5支，新增澳大利亚、菲律宾、日本、韩国、蒙古国等6支球队，不同风格球队同
summary_en: The 2026 Asian University Basketball League concluded on August 11 in Hangzhou, with Shanghai Jiao Tong University defeating Taiwan's Chengchi University 72-69 to win the championship; player Chen Tiancan was named MVP. The tournament's internationalization accelerated: Chinese university teams were reduced from 7 to 5, and six new teams from Australia, the Philippines, Japan, South Korea, and Mongolia were added, allowing teams of different styles to compete.

title: 从思想指引到法治护航（人民观点）
title_en: From Ideological Guidance to Rule-of-Law Safeguards (People's Viewpoint)
summary: 本文从思想指引、实践引领、潮流引领三方面论述中国绿色发展何以引领世界。思想层面，习近平生态文明思想指引人与自然和谐共生，梁家河沼气池、余村“两山”理念、木里矿区整治、长江楚源集团转型等案例体现理念创新、党的领导和法治保障。实践层面，中国经济
summary_en: How China's green development leads the world: Xi Jinping's ecological civilization thought guides harmony between humanity and nature, with cases like Liangjiahe biogas, Yu Village 'two mountains' concept, Muli mine remediation and Yangtze Chuyuan Group transformation showing innovation, Party leadership and rule of law.

title: 伦敦西区的戏梦之旅（旅人心语）
title_en: A Theatrical Dream Journey in London's West End (Traveler's Voice)
summary: 作者在伦敦求学时每日步行于牛津街至河岸街，穿越伦敦西区。西区40余间剧院中，桑德海姆剧院长年上演《悲惨世界》，作者多次观演，见证演员与观众日趋多元年轻；《剧院魅影》《狮子王》《妈妈咪呀！》等让观众穿梭于不同舞台幻梦。文章回顾历史：18至19
summary_en: Walking London's West End from Oxford Street to Strand: Sondheim Theatre's long-running Les Misérables shows increasingly diverse young actors and audiences, while Phantom of the Opera, The Lion King and Mamma Mia! transport audiences through different stage dreams.

title: “专心做好技术攻关这件事”（我在中国创业）
title_en: "Focus on tackling key technologies" (My Startup in China)
summary: 德国工程师科瑞斯与中国妻子蒋筱桦2023年到江苏太仓创办小科智行，专注研发新能源汽车空气悬架压缩机。此前他发现该部件技术老旧、响应迟缓，德国创业困难，遂选择中国。太仓政府提供政策指南、专人帮办和人才扶持，使其专心技术攻关；当地产业链配套高效
summary_en: German engineer Kris and his Chinese wife Jiang Xiaohua came to Taicang, Jiangsu in 2023 to found Xiaoke Zhixing, focusing on R&D of air suspension compressors for new energy vehicles. He had previously found the technology outdated and slow to respond, and starting a business in Germany difficult, so he chose China. The Taicang government provided policy guidance, dedicated assistance and talent support, enabling him to focus on technical breakthroughs; local supply chain support is efficient.
